items.title: The "Impossible" Book of Mormon Challenge | Hugh Nibley REFUTED
items.summary: A Mormon News Roundup YouTube video takes up the claim that Joseph Smith's translation of the Book of Mormon cannot be explained, arguing the book mirrors its 1820s American setting and pointing to its use of King James Bible language, anachronisms and DNA evidence.

items.title: Top Latter-day Saints leader's brother, accused of abusing girls at his Crystal Lake home and church, gets 45 years in prison
items.summary: The Lake and McHenry County Scanner reports that Wade S. Christofferson, 73, brother of a top Latter-day Saints leader, was sentenced to 45 years in federal prison for enticing a 7-year-old girl in Utah. The article says two women allege he sexually abused them as girls in Crystal Lake, Illinois.

items.title: Elder Cook dedicates Modesto California Temple, ‘a place of thanksgiving’
items.summary: Church News reports that Elder Quentin L. Cook dedicated the Modesto California Temple, calling the temple a place of thanksgiving, refuge, instruction and understanding.

items.title: More tickets to tour the renovated Salt Lake Temple will be available Tuesday. See when.
items.summary: The Salt Lake Tribune reports that The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints has announced additional free tour tickets for the renovated Salt Lake Temple will be released Tuesday at 11 a.m. Mountain time. The article says the first 1 million tickets were claimed in less than 24 hours in September and that public tours will run from April 5 through Oct. 1, 2027.
